title: Reuse selection preparation when the workload warrants it
brief: FilterBuilder separates mask preparation from applying it. Consider reusable preparation for many arrays sharing one mask; direct filter remains a simple one-shot choice.

choices.tradeoff: Minimal orchestration; do not assume reusing a builder is faster for this workload.

choices.choose_when: Repeated application of the same mask
choices.tradeoff: Preparation and optimize have costs; measure mask density, sizes and reuse count.

claims.statement: Build from &BooleanArray, optionally optimize, then apply the predicate to arrays/batches with the corresponding row domain.
Reuse changes preparation, not the expected selected values. False and null mask entries are excluded; selected order remains source order.
The optimize documentation describes a tradeoff for repeated use; it is not a universal performance guarantee. Benchmark total setup plus application and keep a direct-filter control.

implementation: Reuse one built predicate only for arrays with the intended shared row domain.
Measure one-shot and repeated cases separately; compare exact outputs before timing.
unknowns: No production throughput claim is established by the equality probe; target-dependent timing is separate.

evidence.scope: Pinned hosted rustdoc; availability depends on the consumer profile.
Only the named assertions in the recorded Cargo profile.

invalidation.reason: Review changed signatures, docs, availability, and newly viable alternatives.
